title: Cakewalks he remembers from boyhood
summary: Asked about cakewalk contests, he recalls only the tune 'Cakewalking Baby'.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Do you recall, Fred, before you left home, any cakewalks where people would dance in order to win the cake? To win the cake. Do you recall any of that?
Something on the order of "Cakewalking Baby"... [HUMS REFRAIN] "Cakewalking Baby." Anything to do in that in the different tempos, they called them cakewalking numbers.
But this particular number was named Cakewalking Baby." But the other numbers, I don't remember

But do you remember any affairs, whether indoor affairs or outside, where there may have been a contest, and the prize of the contest for whoever was the best dancer or the best cakewalker, would win the cake...
Well, they probably had all of that. But I didn't get a chance to see all that.
